Ben — thanks for the heads-up. Policy: standard pilot discount ceiling is 25% list. Anything above that requires VP + CFO approval.

Options to present to Elara quickly:
- Standard: 25% off list for 3 months (no exec signoff)
- Exec pathway: either a one-time credit that preserves our list price (recommended) or a deeper % discount with C-suite signoff

If we go exec pathway, we should package it as a one-time Gross Margin Mitigation Credit rather than changing rate card — better for long-term governance and reporting. Please confirm: projected 18-mo ARR figure, referenceable exec sponsor, and any procurement timing pressure. Also attach pricing-model.xlsx (finance).

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing ask and SOW — need guidance on concession ceiling

Ben/Marissa — did a quick margin run. Assumptions: list pilot value = $300k (3 months at list), expected conversion ARR = $1.2M, gross margin on hosted inference at current stack ~58%.

Impact of concessions:
- 25% pilot discount: incremental gross margin loss ~ $22.5k (pilot period) but preserves list for post-pilot
- 40% discount: incremental GM loss ~ $45k (pilot period)
- One-time credit option: equalizes economics but allows us to keep list price; a one-time credit of $110k achieves parity with 40% concession while smoothing accounting across term (details in pricing-model.xlsx).

Recommendation: if this is strategic and we have confirmed exec sponsor, approve a one-time credit up to $115k (conservative). Anything above $115k needs CFO approval. If we need to be conservative on cash outlay, consider a phased credit tied to usage milestones.

Attached: pricing-model.xlsx (calc summary)

Marcus Lin
Director, FP&A | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing ask and SOW — need guidance on concession ceiling

Ben — buyer psychology note: procurement often asks for a headline % off. We can offer a hybrid: 20-25% headline discount + a performance credit of up to $60k that only kicks in if usage and quality KPIs are met. This reduces immediate cash exposure and gives Elara confidence. Also good for renewal negotiation.

Suggested language for SOW addendum (short):
- Pilot fee: list price less 25% headline discount for 3 months
- Performance credit: up to $60,000 applied as invoice credit if (i) usage >= agreed tokens and (ii) latency/throughput SLA met in pilot window

If commercial wants speed to close, the one-time credit route may be cleaner. I'm fine with either structure from a CS standpoint.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Subject: Internal memo: escalation request for Elara pilot concession (seeking VP/CFO signoff)

Team — compiling final ask for formal signoff. Summary below for Markus (CFO) and Marissa (VP):

Background:
- Elara Health requests 40% off list for a 3-month pilot (expected token volume ~6M; list pilot value ~$300k).
- Executive sponsor: Jenna Lyons (interim CFO) — strong interest and procurement timeline: contract signature requested by Dec 20 to meet board timeline.
- If pilot converts, expected committed ARR ~ $1.2M over 18 months.

Options considered:
A) 25% headline discount for 3 months (internal approval) — low financial impact but may risk losing procurement momentum.
B) One-time Gross Margin Mitigation Credit (preferred) — recommended to preserve rate card and simplify renewal economics. Finance model suggests $110k credit approximate parity with 40% off pilot economics. See pricing-model.xlsx for P&L.
C) Hybrid (25% headline + performance credit up to $60k) — reduces cash outlay and aligns incentives.

Recommendation (commercial): Approve a one-time credit of $110,000 conditional on signed SOW with 18-month minimum term and standard revenue recognition language (credit to be applied across first two invoices). This balances win probability and preserves our post-pilot contract economics.

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx, Elara_SOW_20261201.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/ELR-2026-078

Request: Markus — please sign off if you approve $110k one-time credit (or indicate approved amount). Marissa — please confirm VP commercial endorsement for this pathway. Need decision by EOD Dec 15 to meet Elara procurement deadline.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
